description.de: Kleines Quality Gate fuer direkte Commits auf master: Scope erfassen, schnelle betroffene Checks ausfuehren und ein nachvollziehbares GREEN/YELLOW/RED erzeugen.
description.en: Small quality gate for direct commits on master: capture scope, run fast impacted checks, and produce a traceable GREEN/YELLOW/RED decision.

config.label: Capture the change scope on master
config.command:
cd {{ execution_path }}
set -e
TARGET="{{ git_target }}"

if [ "$TARGET" = "WORKTREE" ]; then
  CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD)
  DIFF_STAT=$(git diff --stat HEAD)
  TARGET_LABEL="WORKTREE vs HEAD"
  LAST_COMMIT=$(git log --oneline -1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
else
  CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "$TARGET")
  DIFF_STAT=$(git diff --stat "$TARGET")
  TARGET_LABEL="$TARGET"
  LAST_COMMIT=$(git log --oneline -1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

echo "target: $TARGET_LABEL"
echo "head_commit: $LAST_COMMIT"
echo "changed_files_count: $COUNT"

if [ "$COUNT" = "0" ]; then
  echo "changed_areas: none"
  echo "tests_changed: no"
  echo "risk_flags: none"
  echo "changed_files: none"
  exit 0
fi

AREA_LIST=""
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^ai-automation-backend/'; then AREA_LIST="$AREA_LIST backend"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^ai-automation-frontend/'; then AREA_LIST="$AREA_LIST frontend"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^scripts/'; then AREA_LIST="$AREA_LIST scripts"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^docs/'; then AREA_LIST="$AREA_LIST docs"; fi
if [ -z "$AREA_LIST" ]; then AREA_LIST=" misc"; fi

RISK_FLAGS=""
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'src/main/.*/(security|auth|permission)|Security|Auth|Permission'; then RISK_FLAGS="$RISK_FLAGS security"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'db/migration|schema|sql$'; then RISK_FLAGS="$RISK_FLAGS database"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'controller|api|webhook|schedule|scheduler'; then RISK_FLAGS="$RISK_FLAGS api-runtime"; fi
if [ -z "$RISK_FLAGS" ]; then RISK_FLAGS=" none"; fi

if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'src/test/|/test/|/tests/|cypress/|playwright/|\.cy\.ts$|Test\.java$'; then
  TESTS_CHANGED=yes
else
  TESTS_CHANGED=no
fi

echo "changed_areas:${AREA_LIST}"
echo "tests_changed: $TESTS_CHANGED"
echo "risk_flags:${RISK_FLAGS}"
echo "--- diff_stat ---"
printf '%s\n' "$DIFF_STAT"
echo "--- changed_files ---"
printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES"

config.label: Run fast impacted checks
config.command:
cd {{ execution_path }}
set +e
TARGET="{{ git_target }}"

if [ "$TARGET" = "WORKTREE" ]; then
  CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD)
else
  CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "$TARGET")
fi

COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
BACKEND_CHANGED=0
FRONTEND_CHANGED=0
PROD_CODE_CHANGED=0
TESTS_CHANGED=0
MIGRATION_CHANGED=0
SECURITY_CHANGED=0
BACKEND_EXIT=0
FRONTEND_EXIT=0

if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^ai-automation-backend/'; then BACKEND_CHANGED=1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^ai-automation-frontend/'; then FRONTEND_CHANGED=1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq '^ai-automation-backend/src/main/|^ai-automation-frontend/src/|^scripts/'; then PROD_CODE_CHANGED=1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'src/test/|/test/|/tests/|cypress/|playwright/|\.cy\.ts$|Test\.java$'; then TESTS_CHANGED=1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'db/migration|schema|sql$'; then MIGRATION_CHANGED=1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq 'src/main/.*/(security|auth|permission)|Security|Auth|Permission'; then SECURITY_CHANGED=1; fi

if [ "$COUNT" = "0" ]; then
  echo "checks_run: none"
  echo "backend_changed: no"
  echo "frontend_changed: no"
  echo "backend_check_exit: skipped"
  echo "frontend_check_exit: skipped"
  echo "prod_code_changed: no"
  echo "tests_changed: no"
  echo "migration_changed: no"
  echo "security_changed: no"
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_description: No changes found in the target range"
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$BACKEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] && [ -f ai-automation-backend/pom.xml ]; then
  echo "=== backend_compile ==="
  (cd ai-automation-backend && mvn -q -DskipTests compile)
  BACKEND_EXIT=$?
else
  echo "=== backend_compile skipped ==="
fi

if [ "$FRONTEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] && [ -f ai-automation-frontend/package.json ]; then
  echo "=== frontend_typecheck ==="
  (cd ai-automation-frontend && npx tsc --noEmit)
  FRONTEND_EXIT=$?
else
  echo "=== frontend_typecheck skipped ==="
fi

if [ "$BACKEND_EXIT" -ne 0 ] || [ "$FRONTEND_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  GATE_STATUS=RED
  GATE_DESCRIPTION="At least one fast area check failed"
elif [ "$PROD_CODE_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$TESTS_CHANGED" -eq 0 ] && { [ "$MIGRATION_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] || [ "$SECURITY_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; }; then
  GATE_STATUS=YELLOW
  GATE_DESCRIPTION="Risky production changes without a visible test update"
elif [ "$PROD_CODE_CHANGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$TESTS_CHANGED" -eq 0 ]; then
  GATE_STATUS=YELLOW
  GATE_DESCRIPTION="Production code changed, but no test change detected"
else
  GATE_STATUS=GREEN
  GATE_DESCRIPTION="Fast area checks passed and no obvious test gap detected"
fi

echo "checks_run: impacted-only"
if [ "$BACKEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "backend_changed: yes"; else echo "backend_changed: no"; fi
if [ "$FRONTEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "frontend_changed: yes"; else echo "frontend_changed: no"; fi
if [ "$BACKEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "backend_check_exit: $BACKEND_EXIT"; else echo "backend_check_exit: skipped"; fi
if [ "$FRONTEND_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "frontend_check_exit: $FRONTEND_EXIT"; else echo "frontend_check_exit: skipped"; fi
if [ "$PROD_CODE_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "prod_code_changed: yes"; else echo "prod_code_changed: no"; fi
if [ "$TESTS_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "tests_changed: yes"; else echo "tests_changed: no"; fi
if [ "$MIGRATION_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "migration_changed: yes"; else echo "migration_changed: no"; fi
if [ "$SECURITY_CHANGED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "security_changed: yes"; else echo "security_changed: no"; fi
echo "gate_status: $GATE_STATUS"
echo "gate_description: $GATE_DESCRIPTION"

if [ "$BACKEND_EXIT" -ne 0 ] || [ "$FRONTEND_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit 1
fi

config.label: Assess the master commit
config.command:
Write a short, critical sanity check for a direct commit on master from the following results.

{{ previous_output }}

Rules:
- Adopt gate_status unless the facts directly contradict it.
- If `frontend_changed: no` or `backend_changed: no`, a `skipped` for that unaffected area is no reason for a downgrade.
- If checks failed: say clearly that master may currently be unstable.
- If production code changed without a test change: name it as a risk, but do not overdramatize it.
- Refer only to facts visible in the output.

Format (Markdown):
## Master Sanity: [GREEN / YELLOW / RED]

### Summary
2-3 sentences.

### Facts
- 3 to 5 concrete points from the output

### Next steps
- 2 to 4 concrete, small recommendations

instructions:
You assess direct commits on master strictly, with reasoning others can follow. Build stability, test gaps and risky change areas come first. No generic quality phrases, only concrete observations from the data supplied.

Run isolation: work only in {{ execution_path }}. The original path {{ project_path }} identifies the project and must not be written to. No automatic merges, pushes or switches to main/master. Changes stay on the run branch for explicit adoption. If a technical check failed, a report must not claim success. Checked commit: {{ workspace_source_sha }}; logs: {{ workspace_logs }}.
